findings.description: The change replaces an explicit `is not None` check with `or`. A field declared with `data_key=""` is valid and gets the empty string as its key everywhere else in the schema. This property now returns `field_name` instead. The `Pluck` field then reads and writes the wrong key when serializing and deserializing a plucked field whose data_key is an empty string. This is an edge case.
findings.suggestion: Restore the explicit check: `return only_field.data_key if only_field.data_key is not None else self.field_name`.
findings.title: Falsy data_key (empty string) now falls back to field_name
